**What is missing**
A clear description of the rule, capability, or use case that is not covered today. If it relates to one of the documented limitations in the README, feel free to reference it.

**Proposed approach**
If you have one in mind, describe how you would implement it. It is fine to leave this blank and discuss it in the issue instead. If this touches a financial data table (PD, LGD, haircuts), please also say where the proposed values would come from.

**Would you be willing to submit a pull request for this?**
Yes / No / Maybe, with some guidance
